views.name: System Overview
views.description: End-to-end multi-tier production architecture: Users, Vercel Frontend, Northflank Express Gateway, PostgreSQL Database, External Services, CI/CD, and Cloud Deployments.

views.name: Frontend Architecture
views.description: React 19 Single Page Application architecture: Dashboard portals, Booking Wizard, API Client layer (apiRequest), useRealtime SSE subscriber, and Auth guards.

views.name: Backend & API Gateway
views.description: Express 5 REST API gateway: Mounted route routers, middleware authentication/role/KYC gates, domain services, and automated background schedulers.

views.name: Database Architecture
views.description: PostgreSQL 15 Prisma schema models, foreign keys, 1:1 and 1:N relations, exact Decimal(12,2) money fields, and transactional advisory locks.

views.name: Booking Lifecycle
views.description: Complete service fulfillment flow: Booking creation -> Auto-dispatch vs Pending claim -> Start PIN + BEFORE photo -> Completion PIN + AFTER photo -> Earnings accrual.

views.name: Realtime / SSE
views.description: Server-Sent Events architecture: /api/realtime endpoint, in-memory connection registry, 25s keep-alive ping, broadcastBookingEvent(), 7 named events, and frontend sync.

views.name: Payments Engine
views.description: Tri-gateway payment processing: PayHere LKR MD5 signatures, NOWPayments Crypto HMAC-SHA512 IPN, Demo mode, atomic subscription activation, and non-refundable coin policy.

views.name: Email & External Services
views.description: External cloud infrastructure: Resend transactional email API, S3 durable object storage, Google OAuth 2.0, PayHere, NOWPayments, Vercel, and Northflank.

views.name: CI/CD Pipeline
views.description: 8-job GitHub Actions CI pipeline: Selective execution classifier (plan-checks.mjs), Protected Files Guard, 01-06 quality checks, and hardened gate.

views.name: Production Deployments
views.description: Decoupled production hosting: Vercel Global Edge (Frontend), Northflank Alpine Container (Backend), and GitHub Pages (Knowledge Graph).

views.name: Knowledge Graph
views.description: Living codebase knowledge graph subsystem: Static analysis AST extractor, deterministic drift validator, and interactive visual network explorer.

views.name: Security Architecture
views.description: Defense-in-depth security engineering: JWT tokenVersion revocation, Bcrypt 10 salt rounds, AES-256-GCM bank account encryption, magic-byte sniffers, and CSP headers.

nodes.label: 🛡️ Auth Gate (Token)

nodes.label: 🛡️ Rate Limiter

nodes.label: 🔒 Bcrypt (10 Rounds)
nodes.description: Adaptive cryptographic key derivation protecting user passwords and 6-digit start/completion PIN codes against brute-force and dictionary attacks.

nodes.label: 🔑 Token Revocation
nodes.description: Stateful invalidation pattern: JWT carries tokenVersion integer. When user resets password or admin deactivates account, tokenVersion increments in PostgreSQL, instantly revoking all active client sessions across all devices.

nodes.label: 🔍 Magic-Bytes Sniffer
nodes.description: Content-based file sniffer checking raw buffer headers (FF D8 FF for JPEG, 89 50 4E 47 for PNG, 25 50 44 46 for PDF) to reject spoofed executable extensions.

nodes.label: 🛡️ CSP & Security Headers
nodes.description: Defense-in-depth HTTP headers enforcing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, HSTS, and strict Content-Security-Policy.

nodes.label: ⚡ Express 5 API Gateway
nodes.description: Central HTTP server configuring security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), strict CORS origins, reverse proxy trust, central Prisma error handling, and background schedulers.

nodes.label: 🔒 AES-256 Banking Crypto
nodes.description: Cryptographic security module encrypting provider bank account numbers at rest using AES-256-GCM (enc:v1:<iv+ciphertext+tag>), paired with non-reversible SHA-256 search hashes and display masking (****1234).

nodes.label: ⏱️ Timeout Background Worker
nodes.description: Continuous background scheduler asserting transactional advisory locks (pg_advisory_xact_lock) to auto-cancel bookings still unassigned at their scheduled start, unstarted bookings after 2h, or uncompleted bookings 2h past end, immediately restoring customer coin entitlements.

nodes.label: 🔌 API Client (apiRequest)
nodes.description: Central HTTP client that injects Authorization Bearer tokens, enforces a 30s AbortController timeout, and purges sessionStorage on 401/403 session revocations.

nodes.label: 🔌 Gateway Integrations
nodes.description: PayHere MD5 signature token generation and timingSafeEqual IPN verification, NOWPayments HMAC-SHA512 verification over sorted JSON keys, and Resend REST email dispatch.

nodes.label: 💰 Monthly Payouts Manager
nodes.description: Gathers all COMPLETED bookings within the calendar month, calculates fixed provider service earnings, and queues idempotent monthly payout records for admin review and bank settlement.

nodes.label: 📡 Realtime SSE Engine
nodes.description: Server-Sent Events manager keeping an in-memory map of authenticated active connections, a 25-second keep-alive ping loop, and targeted role/user event broadcasting via broadcastBookingEvent().

nodes.label: ⚙️ Scheduling & Dispatch
nodes.description: Autonomous provider auto-assignment algorithm; evaluates category capability, geographic service town match, KYC=APPROVED status, ONLINE availability, 2-hour schedule non-overlap, and 5-hour per-provider auto-assignment cooldown inside the 07:00-16:00 Asia/Colombo window.

nodes.label: 📦 S3 Storage Client
nodes.description: Multi-cloud object storage wrapper integrating @aws-sdk/client-s3 with local fallback. Enforces assertStorageConfigured() on production startup to prevent container ephemeral data loss.

nodes.label: 👤 Admin (Platform)
nodes.description: Oversees platform operations, evaluates provider KYC submissions, defines 30-day service packages, resolves complaints, replies to support tickets, and queues monthly provider bank payouts. There is no Super Admin.

nodes.label: 👤 Customer
nodes.description: Purchases 30-day packages, books home services with active category coins, reveals 6-digit start and completion PINs, submits reviews, complaints, and support tickets.

nodes.label: 👤 Provider (Technician)
nodes.description: Submits KYC identity proofs, manages coverage towns and live availability, receives auto-assigned bookings, claims pending jobs, cancels assigned bookings with >=4h notice, verifies Start and Completion PINs with photographic evidence, and tracks earnings.
